facts.fact: The Ministry of ICT and National Guidance's roadmap lists capacity building and skilling of public servants and top government officials in ICT-enabled services and tools, led with the Ministry of Public Service, and a digital fitness programme for public servants; its companion pilot Digital Skills Acceleration Programme 2023/24-2025/26 names public servants among its target groups (dated by the document's publication, 2023).
